architecture.title: Architectural BIM Services
architecture.subtitle: Intelligent 3D Visualization, Constructability & Code Validation
architecture.description: Over the past years, we have successfully implemented BIM for Architects, Building Designers, General Contractors and other Architectural firms within their design and construction processes. Our Architectural BIM services facilitate our clients with digital visualization of their concept design, in an intelligent 3D BIM model, allowing them to make changes within the design before it reaches the construction field.
architecture.overview: The models designed by our BIM experts undergo regular quality checks to ensure the adherence to design discrepancies, coordination issues and constructability. The final validation of design is done as per applicable local and international codes. We work on all prevalent software applications including Revit, AutoCAD, Navisworks and Assets Management.
architecture.sectors: Infrastructure like Metro/rail, residential project, commercials like hotel, restaurants or office premises or building complexes for healthcare/educational purposes such as hospitals, school or colleges, we provide architectural BIM services for all types of construction projects.

subServices.name: Intelligent 3D Concept Visualization
subServices.description: Digital visualization of concept designs in intelligent 3D BIM models, enabling seamless design iteration prior to construction.
features: Parametric 3D architectural modeling from 2D sketches and CAD concepts
Virtual walkthroughs and spatial daylight/circulation simulation
Early-stage design optimization reducing on-site rework

subServices.name: Quality Assurance & Constructability
subServices.description: Rigorous QA/QC protocols to identify design discrepancies and ensure construction feasibility.
features: Regular quality audits for constructability and geometric accuracy
Design discrepancy identification and interdisciplinary coordination
Final validation compliant with local and international building codes

subServices.name: Multi-Sector Project Execution
subServices.description: Tailored BIM delivery across complex infrastructure, commercial, and institutional sectors.
features: Metro & Rail transit corridors and civil infrastructure
Commercial complexes, hotels, restaurants, and office premises
Healthcare facilities, hospitals, schools, and university complexes

subServices.name: Software Stack & Asset Management
subServices.description: Cross-platform model development leveraging the industry's most advanced tools.
features: Autodesk Revit Architecture parametric family and template creation
AutoCAD 2D/3D integration and Navisworks clash coordination
COBie and Asset Management data population for facility handover

interior.title: Structural BIM Services
interior.subtitle: Coordinated Analytical & Geometric Structural Detailing
interior.description: We have a strong team of structural engineers, modelers and drafters thrived to deliver coordinated construction BIM models and documentation, helping you in accurately maintaining your vision throughout the construction process. Our Structural BIM services ensure enhanced coordination between all project stakeholders and furnish an editable analytical representation of structural elements along with the geometric model.
interior.overview: Structural engineers are believed to be captivating a leadership role as far as BIM adoption in the industry is concerned. BIM offers a platform for structural engineers to work more efficiently and accurately with tools that support CAD-based workflows.
interior.sectors: Integrating Revit with Autodesk Navisworks enables the integration of multiple 3D models and data formats into a single model that architects, engineers and contractors can simulate analyse and review for better coordination, conflict resolution and planning, long before construction begins.

subServices.name: Coordinated Construction BIM Models
subServices.description: High-fidelity structural BIM modeling and detailed documentation preserving engineering intent from foundation to superstructure.
features: Detailed modeling of reinforced concrete (RCC), steel frames, and timber systems
Automated generation of structural framing plans, sections, and elevations
Precise coordination between architectural concepts and structural frames

subServices.name: Analytical & Geometric Detailing
subServices.description: Editable analytical representations interconnected with geometric 3D structural members.
features: Bidirectional linking of analytical models with structural analysis engines
Accurate structural member schedules, material properties, and load definitions
Seamless transition between CAD-based drafter workflows and parametric BIM

subServices.name: Multi-Model Integration & Navisworks Simulation
subServices.description: Consolidation of heterogeneous formats into unified models for simulation and pre-construction planning.
features: Autodesk Revit and Navisworks multi-model integration and 4D/5D simulations
Multi-stakeholder review workflows for contractors, engineers, and owners
Virtual constructability reviews long before on-site ground-breaking

subServices.name: Structural Conflict Resolution & QTO
subServices.description: Proactive clash detection and accurate structural material takeoff schedules.
features: Structural rebar and concrete volume quantity take-offs (QTO)
Clash identification between structural frames, MEP routing, and architecture
Rebar shop drawing generation and placement sequencing

bim.title: BIM MEP Services
bim.subtitle: Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing & Fire Protection Engineering
bim.description: BIM Earth Consultancy provides end-to-end multi-disciplinary MEPF BIM modeling, cross-discipline coordination, and clash resolution, ensuring seamless building services integration and accurate material take-offs.
bim.overview: Our MEP division delivers high-precision modeling across Mechanical systems, Electrical infrastructure, Plumbing networks, and Fire Protection systems to eliminate on-site spatial conflicts and optimize installation workflows.
bim.sectors: Applied across residential towers, commercial offices, healthcare facilities, industrial plants, and transit infrastructure hubs worldwide.

subServices.name: Mechanical BIM Services
subServices.description: BIM Earth Consultancy is recognised as an expert in the field of mechanical BIM services for Mechanical BIM modelling, MEP coordination services, MEP Revit family creation, construction simulation and cost estimation of materials related to the MEP domain.
features: HVAC ductwork, air handling units (AHU), and chiller plant 3D modeling
Parametric MEP Revit family creation with custom engineering parameters
Construction simulation, spatial clearance checking, and MEP cost estimation

subServices.name: Electrical BIM Services
subServices.description: With the support of our team of BIM experts, we offer end-to-end solutions for electrical BIM modelling services. We specialize in modelling conduits, electrical equipment, lighting fixtures, cable trays, communication and data transmission devices, fire alarm systems, and network routing.
features: Containment modeling: cable trays, ladder racks, and conduit routing
Lighting fixtures, power distribution panels, and switchgear layouts
Data, communication, security systems, and fire alarm network routing

subServices.name: Plumbing BIM Services
subServices.description: With our plumbing BIM services, one can facilitate 3D visualization of all kinds of plumbing related elements in a building. Our BIM plumbing solutions track coordination and checks for interference for all elements of MEPF BIM, whether fabrication drawings, fittings, spool drawings, or quantity estimation.
features: Domestic water supply, drainage, waste, and vent piping networks
Detailed spool drawings, pipe sleeve layouts, and fabrication documentation
Interference checking and clash-free routing through structural elements

subServices.name: Fire System BIM Services
subServices.description: Revit modelling India is highly competent and renowned for handling fire protection needs effectively and efficiently with the help of its Fire system BIM modelling services. We hold specialisation in fire system BIM modelling, firefighting design, validation and shop drawings, and have emerged as a major MEP BIM modelling and coordination service provider.
features: Sprinkler pipe routing, standpipe systems, and fire pump room detailing
Hydraulic calculation alignment and fire protection code validation
Comprehensive firefighting shop drawings and life-safety MEP coordination

training.title: BIM Training Programs
training.subtitle: Industry-Ready Masterclasses in Revit Architecture, Revit Structure & Navisworks
training.description: Our training courses have the capability to provide the most relevant and up-to-date information working in the real-world environment and market. We enable professionals and students to learn how to effectively manage information across different stages of a construction project for career advancement.
training.overview: All training courses with BIM Earth Consultancy are fully aligned with the latest international BIM standards, making it easier for you to deliver quality projects and meet strict requirements within specified timelines. Our courses provide the essential knowledge needed to graduate as a qualified BIM expert.
training.sectors: Professional training tailored for Architects, Civil & Structural Engineers, MEP Modelers, CAD Drafters, Project Managers, and Engineering Students.

subServices.name: REVIT Architecture Masterclass
subServices.description: Comprehensive hands-on training in Autodesk Revit Architecture from conceptual modeling to complete construction documentation.
features: Parametric building elements, multi-tier wall systems, and curtain walls
Floor plans, elevations, sections, and automated schedule generation
Family creation (RFA) and custom template standardization

subServices.name: REVIT Structure Masterclass
subServices.description: Master structural modeling, reinforcement detailing, and analytical model generation in Revit Structure.
features: Structural columns, beams, foundation footings, and slab systems
3D rebar placement, bar bending schedules (BBS), and structural connections
Linking structural models with analytical design software

subServices.name: Autodesk Navisworks Coordination
subServices.description: Learn multi-disciplinary clash detection, 4D construction scheduling, and project model review.
features: Multi-discipline model aggregation (Architecture + Structure + MEP)
Clash Detective: hard clash, soft clash, and clearance reporting workflows
TimeLiner: 4D construction timeline simulation and walkthrough animation

subServices.name: BIM Standards & Information Management
subServices.description: Learn to manage information effectively across all project lifecycle stages in compliance with industry standards.
features: ISO 19650 BIM workflows, Common Data Environments (CDE), and BEP alignment
Level of Development (LOD 100 - LOD 500) specification standards
Career mentorship, portfolio development, and live project case studies
